closure_definition: Every registered result is machine-closed relative to its canonical typed statement, explicit assumptions, exact source transcriptions, result dependencies, and the listed trusted foundation when every registered proof goal has one accepted replayable proof in both validators.
scope_limits: Closure proves the registered formal statements, not literature priority or empirical ontology.
Source-facing results are conditional on the exact transcriptions whose hashes are registered.
The artifact is result-specific and is not a general-purpose proof assistant.
Written proofs remain the readable mathematical exposition but do not substitute for a failed machine-checked proof.
